sensors.name: line tracker floor brightness (LIGHT mode, LINETRACKER)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the line tracker's floor brightness is below 70 %, drive forward at 40 % indefinitely; otherwise call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; otherwise curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, drive straight through a dark tunnel with no line without touching its walls, and follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's floor brightness is below 70 % (a black line)

branches.outcome: the floor is black: it drives forward at 40 % indefinitely
the floor is not black enough: it calls stopAtWall
an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle is ahead: it calls followLine

branches.reason: followLine is only called when the line tracker already reads 70 % or more, so it cannot then see black, which needs below 50 %.
branches.outcome: it sees black: it curves left
it sees no black: it curves right

equivalence_classes: the line starts again after the tunnel

scenarios.coded_response: On black it drives forward at 40 %; without black it calls stopAtWall, which without an obstacle calls followLine, which curves right; when the line is back it drives forward again. The left-curve branch is unreachable.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line, with nothing ahead, and the line runs on into a tunnel where the line under the robot stops.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads the black line, then no black line in the tunnel, then the line again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line, drives through a tunnel without a line, follows again
assumptions: The tunnel is wide enough for the robot to drive through.
A black line is under the robot before the tunnel and again after it.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line, drives straight through the tunnel without touching its walls, and follows the line again after the tunnel

scenarios.coded_response: It stops while the obstacle is ahead.
